name: Comp S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Comp S.A. is a technology company that delivers a comprehensive array of IT and network security services and solutions across the country. Its offerings span critical security domains such as classified information protection, public key infrastructure (PKI) solutions, and electronic monitoring systems. The company further provides services for securing access, data, mobile devices, infrastructure, and entire networks and systems. Beyond these specialized services, Comp S.A. also delivers corporate and network security, cybersecurity, and audit and advisory services. They offer building technologies and provide system solutions focused on General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance, enhancing business efficiency, and managing information security. Additionally, they are involved in constructing both application and infrastructure systems. Comp S.A. also manufactures various products, including cash register systems, automatic identification systems, weighing equipment, point-of-sale (POS) systems, proprietary software, and electronic transaction solutions. Their service portfolio extends to general IT services, encompassing IT infrastructure and resource management, IT outsourcing, systems integration, and professional consulting. The company serves a broad spectrum of clients in the finance, energy and industrial, public, services, and IT and telecommunications sectors.
